data.name: Tikeshwar
data.gender_notes: Tikeshwar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Lord Tikeshwar is the god of wisdom and knowledge. He is also known as Tirreth or Tirrthankar. He is often depicted as a wise and contemplative figure, with a third eye symbolizing inner knowledge and insight. The name Tikeshwar carries the meaning “God of Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Tikeshwar usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the pursuit of knowledge, wisdom, and inner truth. Encourages introspection and self-discovery. Helps one to overcome ignorance and confusion.
data.etymology: Tikeshwar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God of Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Tikeshwar total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
